scenes.text: Freespins. Cashback. Tournaments. Three ways to keep players coming back, and all three live in one place: the bonus engine inside iPlay Games.

Promotions are usually the slowest part of an operator's week. Freespins credited by hand. Cashback worked out in a spreadsheet. A tournament that needs a developer before it can start. Every campaign costs time you would rather spend on players.

In the back office, freespins are a configuration. Set the rules, restrict the campaign to the games you choose, give it an expiry, and the spins are credited automatically. One screen, and the campaign runs itself.

Cashback and rewards work the same way. Automated cashback programmes, loyalty points, and V I P tiers. Segment your players, target each group with its own offer, and set event-based triggers so the promotion fires on its own. Performance analytics and fraud prevention are built in.

Tournaments add the competitive layer. Prize pools, live leaderboards and real-time rankings, running across the games you pick from fifteen thousand plus titles and a hundred plus studios. Same back office, same integration.
One bonus engine for every promotion you run. Book a walkthrough with our team at iplaygames dot A I. Freespins, cashback, tournaments. iPlay Games.
